bridge.missingDesc: Open this page from the KernelSU or APatch manager.

service.stoppedDesc: Start the service to connect to your tailnet.

overview.connectDesc: While disconnected the service keeps running, so you can reconnect any time.

login.title: Log in to Tailscale
login.desc: This device isn't logged in yet. Log in to join your tailnet.
login.drawerDesc: Open the link in a browser, or scan the QR code with another device.

machineAuth.title: Waiting for approval
machineAuth.desc: This device is logged in, but an admin must approve it before it can connect.

devices.emptyDesc: Your tailnet has no other devices yet.

exitNode.title: Exit node
exitNode.desc: Route this device's internet traffic through another device.
exitNode.allowLanDesc: Keep reaching devices on your LAN directly while using an exit node.

advertise.title: Share this device's network
advertise.exitNodeDesc: Let other devices reach the internet through this one. Needs approval in the admin console.
advertise.routesDesc: Comma separated, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24. Needs approval in the admin console.
advertise.routesInvalid: Enter networks in CIDR form, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24

network.title: Network
network.acceptRoutesDesc: Reach subnets shared by other devices.
network.acceptDNSDesc: Resolve device names with Tailscale DNS.
network.shieldsUpDesc: Other devices can't initiate connections to this one.

device.title: Device name
device.hostnameDesc: Leave empty to use the device model.

service.title: Service
service.modeDesc: Auto uses kernel TUN when /dev/net/tun exists, userspace networking otherwise.
service.restartNeeded: Changes apply after the service restarts.
service.stopConfirmDesc: This device leaves the tailnet, and connections over it (such as adb) drop.

account.title: Account
account.logoutConfirmDesc: This device is removed from the tailnet, and you'll need to log in again.
account.removeConfirmDesc: This device forgets the login for {{account}}; you'll need to log in again to switch back.
